---
applyTo: "src/i18n/**,src/utils/i18nRouting*"
---

# i18n — PaciFinance Rules

## Structure
```
src/i18n/
  languagesConfig.js   # SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — supported languages
  index.js             # imports all locale files
  locales/
    it.json            # Italian (primary)
    en.json            # English
```

## Key Naming Convention
```json
{
  "sectionName": {
    "subsection": {
      "key": "Valore tradotto"
    }
  }
}
```
- Use camelCase for all keys
- Mirror keys exactly in both `it.json` and `en.json`
- Never add a key to one file without the other

## Using Translations
```tsx
// In any component
const { translations } = useContext(LanguageContext);
const text = translations.dashboard.welcome;

// With interpolation (manual)
const msg = translations.goals.progress.replace('{n}', count);
```

## Adding a New Key
1. Add to `src/i18n/locales/it.json` with Italian text
2. Add to `src/i18n/locales/en.json` with English text
3. Use in component via `translations.section.key`

## Adding a New Language
1. `cp src/i18n/locales/en.json src/i18n/locales/xx.json` + translate
2. Add to `src/i18n/languagesConfig.js`:
   ```js
   { code: 'xx', name: 'NativeName', flag: '🏳️', isRTL: false }
   ```
3. Import in `src/i18n/index.js` and add to `languages` object

## URL Routing Utilities (`src/utils/i18nRouting.ts`)
```ts
import {
  LocalizedLink,            // Use instead of <Link>
  useLocalizedNavigate,     // Use instead of useNavigate
  getLanguageFromPath,      // Extract lang from URL
  addLanguageToPath,        // Prefix path with /it/ or /en/
  removeLanguageFromPath,   // Strip language prefix
  isValidLanguage           // Validate language code
} from '../utils/i18nRouting';
```

## Language Change Pattern
```tsx
const navigate = useNavigate(); // raw here — we're changing the lang prefix
const location = useLocation();
const { setLanguage } = useContext(LanguageContext);

const handleLanguageChange = (newLang: string) => {
  setLanguage(newLang);
  const path = removeLanguageFromPath(location.pathname);
  navigate(addLanguageToPath(path, newLang), { replace: true });
};
```

## Locale Keys That Already Exist (don't duplicate)
Common shared keys live in sections: `common`, `errors`, `navigation`, `dashboard`, `profile`, `settings`, `auth`, `goals`, `limits`, `assets`, `incomes`, `outflows`, `rankings`, `roadmap`, `landing`.
